summary: Confirmed DONE. Perf PR #710 (60633eff3) fixes both parts of the finding. Raster images (png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp) skip the text read and render from projects.readFileBinary through a revoked-on-replace blob URL. SVG uses the text read and a data: URL. The dead RichPreviewFileData casts and the sizeBytes/mimeType size guard are removed, and the server's stat-before-read cap now does the guard's job. The disabled text query cannot be revived by refetch: keyOf returns null when disabled, so refreshAsync is a no-op. That means no failing text RPC fires for raster images, including agent-touch refreshes. Browser tests cover raster, scriptable-type refusal and SVG. Some web-only gaps remain next to the fix, and the fix itself duplicates logic. Details are in fixDefects. None of them makes the image preview broken again.

evidence.note: selectedImageSource = resolvePreviewImageSource(path). The text useProjectReadFile query is enabled only when selectedImageSource !== 'raster'.

keyOf returns null for a disabled input, and refreshAsync(null) at :770-773 returns the initial state without fetching. The agent-touch refetch at PreviewPanel.tsx:447 therefore cannot fire a doomed text read for raster images.
The image kind renders with source and refreshKey=latestSelectedFileRefreshKey. The base64-gated branch is gone.

readFileBinary, then the isInertRasterImageMimeType check, then a Blob object URL. The previous URL is revoked after the replacement is ready and the last one on unmount. An active flag guards path-switch races.
SVG renders from a data: URL (opaque origin), never a blob: URL.

readStableFileBytes stats before reading and refuses files over 4 MiB cheaply. readFileBinary sniffs magic bytes (png/jpeg/gif/webp/bmp/ico/avif/heic). The client-side guard was rightly removed rather than revived.
Tests: a raster image renders from a blob: URL with no text read, an image/svg+xml binary result is refused, and SVG renders from a data: URL with no binary read.

The shared classifier (used by mobile, and older than both the report and the fix) has a wider raster set (avif/bmp/heic/ico/tiff), a BINARY_EXTENSIONS list, and workspaceFileReadTransport returning 'none' for known binaries. The web fix added its own parallel resolvePreviewImageSource/IMAGE_EXTENSIONS in PreviewPanel.logic.ts:3,116-122 instead of using it.
runWithRetry retries every readFile failure once, including deterministic node refusals ('Binary files cannot be previewed.', 'too large'). A known-binary or oversized selection costs 2 RPCs.

Over the hosted relay a response above RELAY_MAX_RPC_MESSAGE_BYTES (4 MiB, packages/contracts/src/relay.ts:49) fails only its own request with 'The response exceeded the largest message this connection can carry.' A base64 readFileBinary result passes 4 MiB at about 3 MiB raw, below the node's 4 MiB raw cap.

fixDefects: No regressions, and the core bug is fixed. Adjacent gaps, all low impact. (1) Duplicated, diverging classification. The fix added a web-only IMAGE_EXTENSIONS/resolvePreviewImageSource (apps/web/src/components/PreviewPanel.logic.ts:3,116-122) even though @ryco/client-runtime/state/files previewClassification.ts already owns this decision for mobile. AGENTS.md calls this kind of duplication a code smell. As a result, web shows .bmp/.ico/.avif as kind 'binary': it issues a doomed text read and shows 'Binary files cannot be previewed.', although the node's readFileBinary supports these formats and mobile renders them. (2) Known binaries (zip, pdf, woff, wasm, sqlite, mp4...) still issue the text read on web (PreviewPanel.tsx:409-420). The shared workspaceFileReadTransport would return 'none' for them. The original finding mentioned 'binary kinds' as always failing. That holds only for genuinely binary files, because web's 'binary' kind also covers unknown extensions such as LICENSE, which must still be read. (3) runWithRetry (projectPreviewAtoms.ts:76-84) retries deterministic node refusals, so each doomed read is 2 RPCs, worse over the relay. (4) Over the hosted relay, raster images of roughly 3-4 MiB exceed the 4 MiB reassembled-message ceiling after base64. Their request fails with 'The response exceeded the largest message this connection can carry.' This was already true for ChatMarkdown, DiffImagePreview and mobile, and is now reachable from the preview panel. (5) Nit: a failed raster read keeps the previous blob URL (up to 4 MiB) alive until the next successful load or unmount (PreviewImage.tsx:57-64,79-85).
implementationSketch: Optional follow-up, web only, no protocol change. (a) In apps/web/src/components/PreviewPanel.logic.ts, drop the local IMAGE_EXTENSIONS/resolvePreviewImageSource. Derive transport from classifyWorkspaceFilePath + workspaceFileReadTransport (@ryco/client-runtime/state/files): 'image' -> PreviewImage raster, 'svg' -> PreviewImage svg, 'binary' -> no read plus a static 'Binary files cannot be previewed.' state, everything else -> text read. Keep web's own detectPreviewFileKind only for editability and language, so unknown extensions do not suddenly become editable. That would be a separate product choice. In PreviewImage, add an fallback ('This browser can't display this image format.') because Chrome cannot decode heic/tiff. Gate PreviewPanel.tsx:418 on transport === 'text'. (b) In apps/web/src/rpc/projectPreviewAtoms.ts, make runWithRetry skip the retry when classifyWorkspaceFileReadError(error.message) is anything other than 'error', since the oversized/binary/encoding/not-file/missing/unsupported-image refusals are deterministic. (c) Optionally free the previous blob URL when a raster read fails (revoke and null objectUrlRef in the catch when the requestKey changed). Tests: extend PreviewPanel.browser.tsx with a .bmp or .ico raster case that does a binary read and no text read, a .zip case where neither read fires, and a refusal case asserting readAttempts has length 1. Extend PreviewPanel.logic.test.ts for the transport mapping. Item (4), the relay ceiling vs the 4 MiB binary cap, is a separate cross-client limit question: lowering PROJECT_READ_FILE_BINARY_MAX_BYTES to about 3 MiB for relayed reads, or mapping the defect text to 'too large to preview over this connection'. Do not fold it into this change.
decisionReason: The follow-up is web-only classification and retry cleanup that reuses an existing shared module. No auth, E2EE, hosted lifecycle or Hub protocol change is needed. Only the optional relay-ceiling alignment (item 4) would need a cross-client limit decision, and it is deliberately kept out of this change.
